canonicalSeam.worldSemantics: RSR and Experience Fabric continue to own cue identity, fixed-tick timing, spatial parameters, listener meaning and offline audio semantics.

stressCase: The same explicit content-addressed audio target must survive Android APK packaging, synthetic-origin WebView loading, app-private CacheStorage persistence and cold reload while preserving VSR receipt-root continuity.
donorAdvantage: The existing VSR browser cache and Reality Build synthetic-origin Android host already provide the required persistence seam; no native Android cache bridge or parallel audio asset loader was added.
regressionCase: After application-data clear the target records one cache miss/write; after cold reload it rehydrates the same revision and manifest with one cache hit, one ready asset and one scheduled receipt, while the intentionally forced-reset race is excluded from the cache verdict.
boundaries: This is an API 35 Android ATD Emulator/WebView candidate, not physical-device or production-device acceptance.
The APK is debug-signed, not a release-signed APK/AAB or store-delivery artifact.
CacheStorage persistence, byte budget and hit behavior are one emulator profile observation, not an Android quota guarantee or cross-device performance curve.
A scheduled Web Audio buffer receipt proves target execution and decode scheduling only; it does not prove audible output, native speaker routing, latency, mixing quality or human listening.
No target-side voice cap, mixer/bus policy, continuous-stream policy or latency budget was introduced or verified.
No K400 gate is promoted to PASS.
nextCandidate: Retain the shared cache contract and determine whether Android quota/eviction/performance or target-side voice/mixer/continuous-stream policy has a canonical owner; physical-device listening remains a separate human gate.
